key_impacts: Across Bangladesh, Cyclone Aila washed away 243,191 houses and left 370,587 houses partially damaged.
In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 33 people were killed.
In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 3,520 houses were washed away and 1,800 houses were partially damaged.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in six places in Dakshin Bedkashi, damaging 20.55 km of embankment (out of 27.37 km).
Villages in Dakshin Bedkashi were inundated twice daily by tidal water until coastal polders were rehabilitated in 2013.
missing_information: Locations beyond Koyra/Dakshin Bedkashi affected by Aila are not enumerated in detail in this source.
